tier_reason: Tier C stands; caveats corrected: the EPYC leads over randompack (1.26x uniform, 1.03x normal) were measured against randompack's scalar fallback because the CRAN 0.1.10 build never defines BUILD_AVX2, and zurand alone requests 2 MiB pages; the NEON-vs-NEON M1 rows (1.15x uniform, about 1.0x normal) are the fair peer comparison.

corrections.caveats: First-party benchmark workflow against R packages (dqrng, base R, randompack), not std::mt19937, xoshiro or PCG directly; compiler unnamed (EPYC 7763, M1). The x86_64 randompack baseline (CRAN 0.1.10) is built without AVX2, so the EPYC leads (1.26x uniform, 1.03x normal) are over a scalar fallback; on the M1 with NEON on both sides zurand is 1.15x on uniform and 0.97-1.03x on normals. zurand alone requests 2 MiB pages on madvise-mode kernels; threaded rows not like for like; min/max and mean/sd only; 0 stars.
